newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Sweden to finance $35 mln Vietnam hydropower plant.
newsitem.headline: Sweden to finance $35 mln Vietnam hydropower plant.

text.p: Sweden said on Friday it had agreed to finance a $35 million hydropower plant in central Vietnam.

A statement issued by Stockholm's Hanoi embassy said Sweden would provide $31 million in soft credit for equipment, and a $5.4 million grant for construction, supervision and environmental management.
The deal was signed by Minister for Planning and Investment, Do Quoc Sam and Pierre Schori, Sweden's Minister for International Development and Cooperation, currently visiting Vietnam.
The statement quoted Schori as saying a commitment to continued and deepened reforms would make Vietnam eligible for additional soft loans and balance of payments support.
Vietnam introduced market-oriented reforms in the late 1980s, but foreign diplomats have recently expressed concern that the impetus behind the reform process may be weakening.
